critique: The render has the correct black-background, cool blue particle-field character and does show fluid-driven random swirls that change substantially between the two frames. However, it reads more as a dense, noisy starfield than a clearly legible swirling grid: the organized grid/strand structure is weak, with large uneven clumps and many oversized bright particles competing with the finer motion. The forced single slate-blue color also reduces the richer vendor-preset-style tonal separation.

suggestions.why: Reduce the extreme particle/string size variation so the underlying swirling grid structure remains readable instead of being dominated by scattered large bright dots.
Slightly raise particle opacity to retain visible fine swirl strands after reducing the oversized-particle emphasis.
